justification: `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeWriter.java` defines `MethodPool` as a 1,184-line nested block (lines 398-1581) containing the `Record` API, `Sort` enum, multiple concrete record implementations (`ForNonImplementedMethod`, `ForDefinedMethod.WithoutBody`, `WithBody`, `WithAnnotationDefaultValue`, `OfVisibilityBridge`, `AccessBridgeWrapper`), and helper types (`VisibilityBridge`, `AccessorBridge`, `BridgeTarget`). `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeWriterMethodPoolRecordTest.java` exercises many distinct behaviors for skipped, defined, default-value, implemented, visibility-bridge, and accessor-bridge records, showing several separable responsibilities are packed into one unit.
